candidates.title: Add the SAGE continuous-improvement feedback loop
candidates.request: agreed, make it so, but remember frequent pushes to a feature branch is good practice

confidence_basis: Repository-owned discovery, evidence, publisher, indexer, and guardrail patterns already exist.
Kubecost, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and published SAGE evidence provide baseline inputs.
Lesson extraction, longitudinal metrics, prediction scoring, and candidate lifecycle tooling do not yet exist.
assumptions: The first version will preserve raw metrics and will not create a composite quality score.
The repository-only foundation will not mutate the cluster or materially change recurring run rate.
Existing SAGE evidence and deployment workflows remain authoritative.
known_unknowns: How much historical terminal evidence can be classified automatically with acceptable accuracy.
Which observability and Kubecost queries can be normalized across different change classes.
How many comparable sessions are required before T-shirt boundaries and confidence calibration are statistically useful.
failure_conditions: The implementation creates a parallel authority path instead of extending repository-owned SAGE.
Recorded predictions can be overwritten after outcomes are known.
A staged implementation can activate without an explicit open deployment gate.
Metrics reward documentation volume instead of improved engineering outcomes.

basis: The repository governance surface is defined and testable.
The historical evidence baseline is rich but is not yet normalized into lessons and process metrics.
No cluster mutation is required for the governance and tooling foundation.

recurring_run_rate_delta.basis: The repository-only foundation adds no cluster workload.

avoidable_rework_cost.initial_target: Establish a measurable baseline before claiming savings.

signals: post-change workload readiness and restart counts

implementation_outline: Establish continuous-improvement authority, policy, schemas, registries, and guardrails.
Implement machine-readable lessons and experience-aware preflight.
Implement process metrics, prediction scoring, confidence calibration, and T-shirt sizing.
Integrate Kubecost and observability baseline and comparison inputs.
Implement candidate-registry and staged-implementation lifecycle tooling.
Add baseline extraction, scorecards, regression tests, and negative tests.
validation_plan: Validate every policy, schema, and registry JSON document.
Run representative and negative contract tests.
Require continuous-improvement discovery for relevant requests.
Run root SAGE guardrails after every cohesive commit.
Push every cohesive validated commit to the feature branch.
Keep deployment and activation gates closed until final validation.

deployment_gate.reason: The continuous-improvement foundation remains a staged implementation under active development.

triggers: the workstream is selected for activation

candidates.title: Add live SAGE session metrics and metrics-pilot discovery
candidates.request: Begin the first fully instrumented Kalaxy3 SAGE metrics pilot. Register the change, prediction, baseline, and canonical session before implementation. Capture raw delivery and learning metrics from the first command onward, preserve operations and economics as separate feedback planes, keep unavailable measurements null, and do not enable a composite score or open any deployment gate.

confidence_basis: Continuous-improvement schemas, registries, scoring, and guardrails already exist.
The missing work is limited to live event capture, metrics-pilot discovery classification, registry integration, and validation.
The current tools have no supported live-session registration interface, creating bootstrap uncertainty.
assumptions: The first pilot remains repository-only and does not mutate the cluster.
Raw events are captured externally until the repository-owned recorder is committed.
Operations and economics remain separate and may be recorded as no-change or unavailable.
known_unknowns: Whether the current schemas need a distinct active-session or event-ledger contract.
How much command metadata can be captured without recording secrets.
Whether candidate registration needs a new repository-owned append-only tool.
failure_conditions: Repository mutations occur outside the metrics runner after this bootstrap.
The pilot invents historical command counts for the excluded pre-ledger work.
A composite score or deployment gate is enabled.

basis: The continuous-improvement foundation, candidate registry, scoring, and guardrails already exist.
The repository lacks a canonical active-session ledger and live command-event recorder.
The pilot is repository-only and keeps the deployment gate closed.

recurring_run_rate_delta.basis: The pilot adds repository tooling and no cluster workload.

avoidable_rework_cost.initial_target: Establish the first canonical session baseline without claiming savings.

measurement_provenance: repository-owned Git and SAGE guardrail output

implementation_outline: Register the metrics pilot candidate and its immutable discovery prediction.
Classify metrics-pilot and live-session requests as continuous-improvement work.
Add a canonical active-session event ledger and repository-owned live metrics recorder.
Import the bootstrap external ledger without inventing excluded historical command counts.
Close the session into the canonical session registry, score predictions, and perform the post-session review.
Publish implementation evidence and derive evidence-backed improvement actions.
validation_plan: Require the exact metrics-pilot request to infer continuous-improvement before further mutation.
Validate candidate schema and registry contracts.
Preserve raw event data and keep unavailable measurements null.
Run session, feedback, candidate, learning, review, and full root SAGE guardrails.
Commit and push every cohesive validated change.
Keep the deployment gate closed and perform no cluster mutation.

deployment_gate.reason: The metrics pilot is repository-only and must not activate workloads or mutate the cluster.

triggers: the raw metrics ledger format changes
the pilot scope expands beyond repository tooling
